Brand system

Everything an agency or a partner needs, including the rules we hold ourselves to.

The mark

A single unbroken line folded into a W. Continue its lines and the loop completes into a fingerprint. The ring frames the mark wherever it stands alone.

Construction
Square icon. One stroke weight governs the whole mark: 6.84% of the icon width, on both the ring and the W.
Clear space
A quarter of the icon diameter on every side.
Minimum size
24px for the icon, 96px wide for the horizontal lockup.

Colour

Navy

#012A5D · 14.09:1 on white

Navy deep

#001A3D · dark grounds

Navy mid

#14427F · panels on dark

Sky

#8DB8FF · 7.0:1 on navy

Ice

#EAF1FB · light tint

Lime

#C8F560 · 11.19:1 with navy

White

#FFFFFF · paper

—

#F4F8FE · derived tint

Lime is a fill, never ink on white (1.26:1). It carries navy text at 11.19:1. Sky is never used for text on white (2.01:1).

Type

Teach the world

Teach the world

JetBrains Mono · labels, code and metadata only

Lexend sets every Latin word: weight 200 for display, 600 for emphasis, 400 for body. The Arabic pair (Milan Display / Tajarib) is specified in the brand book and ships with the RTL variant.

Misuse

  • Don't stretch, squash or rotate the mark.
  • Don't place navy on a dark ground, or lime on a light one.
  • Don't retype the wordmark.
  • Don't fill the ridges motif.
